test_cases.name: 041_01_01 Query Context Source Registration Subscriptions
test_cases.doc: Check that you can query context source registration subscriptions
test_cases.setup: Setup Initial Context Source Registration Subscriptions
test_cases.teardown: Delete Created Context Source Registration Subscriptions
test_cases.then:
then {
    the SUT sends a valid Response for the operations:
        Query Context Source Registration Subscriptions with Response Status Code set to 200     and
        Query Context Source Registration Subscriptions with Response containing:
            * file set to 'csourceSubscriptions/expectations/subscriptions-035-01-expectation.json'
            * id set to '${subscription_ids}'
            * response set to '${response.json()}'
}
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/csourceSubscriptions'
        method set to 'GET'
        Query Context Source Registration Subscriptions and
    Query Parameter: context set to 'https://forge.etsi.org/rep/cim/ngsi-ld-test-suite/-/raw/develop/resources/jsonld-contexts/ngsi-ld-test-suite-compound.jsonld'
}
